title: MA61032: Theory Of Operators
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Functional Analysis Bounded linear operators on Banach and
Hilbert spaces, self-adjoint and normal operators, compact operators,
Fredholm alternatives, Eigen-values and eigen vectors, spectrum, spectral
theory, Banach algebra of bounded linear opertors, unbounded operators,
nonlinear operators, monotone, strictly monotone and strongly monotone
operators.
